note: Single-pass extraction by Claude reading the paper text; evidence references sections/figures/tables. No multi-run validation.

components.description: DUD: decoupled causal tracing, discovered fragility patterns, and probe performance

nodes.name: Output probabilities miss epistemic state
nodes.description: Logit- and sampling-based uncertainty metrics focus on final output distributions, capture mainly aleatoric ambiguity, and can give high confidence while internal reasoning is unstable.

nodes.name: Aggregation hides module conflict
nodes.description: Existing mechanistic UQ methods (SAPLMA, Lookback Lens, DoLa, ICR Probe) merge memory and context signals into unified representations, obscuring conflicts between parametric memory and contextual cues that signal failure.

nodes.name: FFN and MHSA play distinct roles
nodes.description: FFNs act as key-value memories for parametric knowledge while multi-head self-attention routes contextual information.

nodes.name: Decoupled causal tracing
nodes.description: DUD runs a clean pass, a corrupted pass (Gaussian noise added to input embeddings, Total Effect TE = mean drop in token probability), and patch runs that restore only the Attention or only the FFN output at each layer.

nodes.name: Restoration scores and 2L profile
nodes.description: Each module's layer-wise restoration score (probability recovered divided by TE) forms a 2L-dimensional dynamic profile used as the feature vector of the DUD-Probe.

nodes.name: Early-layer attention fluctuation
nodes.description: Across datasets, restoration scores in early layers (0-5) fluctuate strongly between correct and incorrect predictions for both Attention and FFN, indicating encoding-phase routing instability.

nodes.name: Late-layer FFN collapse
nodes.description: In late layers (20-28) FFN restoration scores collapse while Attention stays stable, marking a parametric-memory failure that indicates uncertainty.

nodes.name: Task-dependent patterns
nodes.description: Context-rich HaluEval shows larger early-layer instability, whereas knowledge-intensive HotpotQA shows larger late-layer FFN shifts.

nodes.name: Layer-wise AUROC signal
nodes.description: On LLaMA3.1-8B, individual layers discriminate correct from incorrect outputs, with best FFN layer 24 (AUROC 0.767) and best Attention layer 20 (0.745).

nodes.name: Instability predicts errors
nodes.description: On SQuAD (layer 24), error rate rises from 16.8% in the robust quadrant (both modules within bounds) to 72.0% in the dual-deviant quadrant.

nodes.name: Confidence inversion
nodes.description: Logit confidence fails to track mechanistic risk: stubborn errors stay confident in stable states while correct answers in deviant states have low confidence.

nodes.name: DUD-Probe beats baselines
nodes.description: The DUD-Probe achieves state-of-the-art AUROC over three LLMs and four datasets, e.g. +17.4% over Semantic Entropy on LLaMA-3.1 HaluEval and +5.0% over the aggregated ICR Probe on Qwen2.5, with AUROC 0.949 on LLaMA-3.1 HaluEval.

nodes.name: Strong cross-dataset transfer
nodes.description: DUD-Probe degrades under 5% out-of-distribution versus 15-20% for baselines, e.g. TriviaQA->SQuAD 0.868 vs ICR 0.613 and TriviaQA->HaluEval 0.930.

nodes.name: Both streams needed
nodes.description: On Llama-3.1-8B, Attn Only and FFN Only probes beat random, but the full dual-stream probe is best on all datasets (e.g. HaluEval 0.9487 vs 0.9144 and 0.8968).

nodes.name: No single golden layer
nodes.description: Removing early, middle or deep layer groups each lowers AUROC (w/o early layers drops HaluEval 0.95 -> 0.85), so uncertainty signals are distributed across depth.

nodes.name: Case studies of faithfulness
nodes.description: DUD gives a low score (0.08) to a confident wrong answer (logit confidence 0.96) and a high score (0.72) to a hesitant correct one (logit confidence 0.35).

isolated_nodes.name: White-box and latency limits
isolated_nodes.description: DUD is inapplicable to closed-source API models and its multiple forward passes (clean, corrupted, patched) add inference latency over logit-based methods.

isolated_nodes.name: Robust to labeling threshold
isolated_nodes.description: DUD outperforms baselines on Qwen2.5-7B across varying ROUGE-L correctness thresholds (Table 2), showing robustness to labeling criteria.

structural_reasoning: Limitations of output-based and aggregated UQ motivate decoupled tracing; the restoration profile reveals fragility patterns that feed the probe, whose performance, transfer, and ablations validate the decoupling.
